card.name: Sentence ends and gaps in clinical text
card.fires_on: Punctuation or spaces at a clause or sentence boundary in drug-label and medical text, and some positions partway through drug names or numbers. The next word often starts a new statement about patients.

modes.label: Sentence-ending period
modes.description: A period closing a sentence about patients or treatment, just before a new sentence.

modes.label: Space after names or numbers
modes.description: A space after an author credential or a number, before the next name, year, or age.
modes.example: John P. Cunha, DO, FACOEP<< >>John P. Cunha, DO

modes.label: Inside drug names or units
modes.description: A single letter or short piece partway through a drug name, unit, or enzyme name.
